This market will resolve to "Yes" if Carnell Tate's average fantasy points per game during the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) equals or exceeds 12.5 under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. Only regular season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. There is no minimum number of games played. If the listed player does not appear in any 2026-27 NFL regular season game, this market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the per-game averages cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).
